intro: Project work has covered eight states and five basins: deep gas development in northwest Louisiana and East Texas, oil-directed drilling in southern Mississippi, stacked Marcellus and Utica programs in Pennsylvania and Ohio, shallow biogenic gas across northern Michigan, and utility-scale renewable siting in eastern Washington.
